name: Junis Greaves
role: Watch captain keeping the harbour chain and the Quay
appearance: Stocky and sunburnt, a tide-table tucked in his gorget strap.
voice: Blunt and practical; talks in prices and tides.
backstory: One of Halda's six captains, who keeps the harbour chain and the Quay. He voted with Halda on day 9 to open the gates. House Mostana's galleys, the Sixth Daughter and the Patient Gull, lie at anchor under his chain.
wants: The harbour open and the grain moving; his wardens paid.
fears: A closed harbour starving the city; a gold-bought captain on his own watch.

relationships.how: the Factor whose galleys lie at anchor under his chain; he watches her closely
knows him as a hired sword on Watch jobs

secrets: You know House Mostana has been lending gold to Lorard's army, from what the galley crews let slip at your chain; you have told no one.
dm_only: Only his name, rank and the galleys at anchor are canon. Invented by npc-creator: the harbour-chain post, his age, voice, appearance, alignment, the Veteran stat block, and that he knows of the Mostana loan (the loan itself is canon, see lorard-hask). Remove if unwanted.
The day-9 vote was four captains to one; he is among the four.
